## About
Robert's Automotive Repairs is a car repair and maintenance shop in Lewisville, Texas. We're open weekdays and closed on the weekend, and you can request an appointment by telling us the year, make and model of your vehicle and what it needs.
We try to be straight with you about your car. That means telling you which repairs are critical and which ones can wait, and no surprises at checkout. Our word is our bond.
One reviewer, a widowed woman, said Willie explained everything in laywoman's terms without being patronizing, and that it was the most comfortable she has ever felt getting auto repairs done.

## Services
- Oil changes: Oil changes starting at $79.99. (Starting at $79.99)
- Free tire rotation with oil change: Your tire rotation comes free with an oil change.
- Brake packages: Brake packages starting at $179.99. (Starting at $179.99)
- A/C recharges: A/C recharges starting at $99.99 to keep you cool on Texas roads. (Starting at $99.99)
- Coolant flushes: Coolant flushes starting at $129.99. (Starting at $129.99)
- Free vehicle inspections: Bring your car in for an inspection at no charge. (Free)
- Diagnostics: We use high tech diagnostic equipment to track down what's wrong.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Do you work with warranty companies?
A: Yes. We work with all warranty companies.

Q: How do I request an appointment?
A: Fill out the appointment request form with your name, contact info, the year, make and model of your vehicle, and the services you need.
